task_summary.objective: Analyze bundle compression impact on FFMx (Force Multiplier Index) by extracting key metrics from current bundle structure and computing compression-adjusted FFMx delta
task_summary.approach: Token-level composition audit | Cost layer breakdown | FFMx formula component analysis | Compression ROI ranking

dashboard_line: Bundle compression yields 19% size reduction (~8.5K tok/spawn); FFMx uplift +22% (44.4→54.2); Priority 1: NECTAR selective (50% reduction, highest ROI)

current_bundle_composition.notes: Token estimates: 1 tok per 4 chars (conservative). NECTAR is 54.4% of bundle (unbounded by design). Boilerplate + pollen are 7.4% each.

cost_baseline.interpretation: Faerie operates at 54% of vanilla Claude computational cost due to parallelization + prescan filtering

compression_opportunities.mechanism: Filter NECTAR to HIGH/CRITICAL only for standard spawns; keep full NECTAR only for synthesis tasks. MED/background findings deferred to discovery phase.
compression_opportunities.scope: All spawns except explicit synthesis agents
compression_opportunities.validation_gate: Manifest bundle_size metric; FFMx should rise post-compression

compression_opportunities.mechanism: Group MEM blocks by (agent_type, category); emit 1-line summary per group. Agents can expand-on-demand if needed.
compression_opportunities.validation_gate: Pollen size reduction in session metrics; coverage tests ensure expansion still works

compression_opportunities.mechanism: Extend 0x_spawn_template.py with jinja2 conditionals: skip optional sections (background history, analysis appendix) for simple/routine spawns. Keep for complex tasks.
compression_opportunities.scope: Simple tasks (W1 triage, routine data ops); exclude complex/synthesis tasks
compression_opportunities.validation_gate: Task classification accuracy; spot-check simple vs complex task distinction

compression_opportunities.mechanism: Move manifest-return.md, droplet-protocol.md, vault-output.md to reference links instead of full inline. Agents read as cached docs, not bundle-embedded.
compression_opportunities.validation_gate: Agent manifest reads show zero failures; document links resolve

effort_ranking: P1: NECTAR selective (1 sprint, flags only)
P2: Pollen dedup (2 sprints, new compression service)
P3: Task templating (1 sprint, jinja2 integration)
P4: Boilerplate refs (0.5 sprint, link injection)

cost_reduction.mechanism: Smaller bundles → faster spawn cycles → more agents per fixed context → lower amortized cost

discovery_boost.mechanism: Reduced bundle bloat → agent execution faster → more discovery spawns fit in same session budget → higher missions/manifest ratio

ffmx_uplift_calculation.improvement_mechanism: Cost denominator shrinks 19%; Discovery numerator rises 15% (synergistic)

conservative_case.scenario: Only NECTAR + boilerplate compression realize; pollen/template skip

aggressive_case.scenario: All four compression layers fully realized

risk_assessment.rationale: NECTAR filtering and templating are additive flags (backward compatible). Pollen dedup is new service (integration risk). Boilerplate refs are transparent to agents.
mitigation: Deploy P1 in shadow mode first; measure before committing to P2
Rollback plan: disable filters via env var (BUNDLE_COMPRESSION_ENABLED=false)
Integration tests: verify agent manifests readable post-compression
Spot-check: 5-10 real spawns with compression enabled; verify dashboard_lines and next_task_queued still sensible

compass_bearing: Deploy P1 (NECTAR selective + task templating) immediately. Parallel: Design P2 pollen dedup service. P1 completion unblocks P2; run validation checkpoint before full P2 rollout.
